purpose: Deterministic adversarial fixtures for every major PIT boundary. This file contains no real security, capital, or trading decision.

patch_dialect.pointer: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer within the named artifact

phase.before_hash: Apply before canonical hashes and artifact files are materialized.
phase.coherent_after_refresh: Apply after derived bindings are refreshed, then re-seal the changed artifact and update its request hash without re-deriving semantic truth.
phase.after_hash: Apply after declared hashes are frozen; used only to test integrity rejection.

tokens.@AUTO_FILE_SHA256:<name>: SHA-256 of the materialized named artifact
tokens.@AUTO_POPULATION_KEY_SET_SHA256: Canonical SHA-256 of the sorted population security-time keys
tokens.@AUTO_POPULATION_RECEIPT_HASH: Canonical SHA-256 of population_manifest excluding receipt_hash
tokens.@AUTO_POPULATION_SOURCE_RECEIPT_HASH: Canonical SHA-256 of population_source excluding receipt_hash
tokens.@AUTO_LABEL_SPEC_HASH: Canonical SHA-256 of label_definition excluding label_spec_hash
tokens.@AUTO_FILE_SHA256:label_schedule: SHA-256 of the separate executable label schedule artifact
tokens.@AUTO_FILE_SHA256:review_authority: SHA-256 of the independent semantic-review authorization artifact
tokens.@AUTO_FILE_SHA256:label_interval_authori: SHA-256 of the independent exact-interval authority artifact
tokens.@AUTO_CONTRACT_CANONICAL_HASH: Canonical SHA-256 of contract excluding canonical_hash
tokens.@AUTO_<POLICY>_SHA256: SHA-256 of the exact frozen corporate-action, overlap, purge, or embargo policy text
tokens.$copy + $overrides: Inside an add value, deep-copy the JSON Pointer from the same artifact, then apply the listed top-level field replacements.

prediction_time.definition: Timestamp when the signal is fixed.

event_time.definition: Fiscal period end represented by the observation.

vendor_available_time.definition: First timestamp exposed in the declared vendor product.

ingested_time.definition: Historical landing timestamp in the research store.

ingestion_batch_id.definition: Immutable historical batch containing the exact consumed object; nullable only for a market-level claim.

ingested_object_sha256.definition: SHA-256 of the exact historical object received by the research system; nullable only for a market-level claim.

label_start_time.definition: Left endpoint of the label interval.

label_end_time.definition: Right endpoint of the label interval.

universe_member.definition: Membership under the frozen universe rule.

universe_effective_to.definition: Exclusive membership-effective end; null means still effective.

security_status.definition: PIT active, delisted, or suspended state.

revision_known_time.definition: First availability of the selected vintage.

adjustment_known_time.definition: First availability of the applied factor; null for RAW.

adjustment_invariance_pass.definition: Result of the declared return-invariance test; null when not applicable.

halt_time.definition: Start of a trading halt; null when none.

identifier_valid_to.definition: Exclusive validity end; null means open-ended.

revenue_ttm.definition: Trailing-twelve-month revenue from the selected original vintage.
revenue_ttm.grain: security, fiscal period, and filing vintage
revenue_ttm.null_semantics: not nullable in the consumed-value view

time_rules.label_start_rule: Use the exact consumed label_start_time at or after prediction_time.
time_rules.label_end_rule: Use the exact consumed label_end_time after label_start_time.
time_rules.holding_period: Use the frozen exact per-sample interval set.

contract.label_formula: Synthetic raw close-to-close return over the declared interval.
contract.neutralization_rule: No neutralization is used in this synthetic audit fixture.

cases.description: Complete market-reconstructible evidence; later local ingest is disclosed but does not change the claim.
The production CLI cannot qualify the deterministic test-only contract adapter.
Historical ingest and parse-ready timestamps also precede prediction.
A clean sample cannot prove full-input PIT correctness.
The vendor first exposes the feature after prediction.
LE includes a vendor-availability timestamp exactly equal to prediction_time.
LT excludes a vendor-availability timestamp exactly equal to prediction_time.
Public availability is timely, but the historical system had not ingested or parsed it.
System timestamps alone cannot prove which exact object the historical system held.
A missing system receipt cannot downgrade a known late ingest and parse violation from FAIL to NEEDS_EVIDENCE.
Current membership is backfilled before the constituent change was announced.
The PIT membership interval is half-open, so prediction_time equal to effective_to is ineligible.
A prediction immediately before the exclusive effective_to endpoint remains eligible.
Fiscal period end is placed in the publication field; old dates must not silently pass availability.

cases.description: A later filing revision is selected before that revision was known.
A current full-history factor changes a non-return value before the factor was known.
The extraction receipt expects two population keys but only the surviving key is present.
A timezone-naive prediction timestamp cannot be aligned safely.
The versioned session closes before the declared tradable time.
A declared tradable timestamp exactly at the session close remains inside the session boundary.
A tradable timestamp immediately after the declared close is outside the session.
Quotes resume before the intended trade, but trading resumes afterward.
A second row ID repeats the same security, prediction, and feature grain.
An OOS label interval intersects a TRAIN label interval without purge.
Within-split interval dependence is reported but does not become a cross-split failure.
LEFT label intervals in different splits may touch at one shared boundary without overlapping.
BOTH label intervals in different splits overlap when one ends exactly where the next starts.
The target interval begins before the prediction is fixed.
The semantic assertion exists but is not traceable to a dictionary or vendor location.
Valid JSON with an invalid nested feature-map shape emits a structured rejection instead of aborting with exit 64.
The contract file exists, but its frozen validation cannot be proven.
A consumed value is changed after the snapshot digest is frozen.
The audit cannot guess whether the frozen snapshot is the consumed file or an upstream container.
A source-container claim remains unresolved until an independent extraction receipt binds exact output bytes.
A consumed numeric value is non-finite.
The feature violates its sourced non-negative hard domain.
The dictionary explicitly identifies the key as a changeable ticker.
A listed population key without an exact external source locator is only self-asserted.
A materialized training key omitted from an otherwise self-consistent population receipt must fail.
A null membership end declared UNKNOWN cannot prove an open-ended eligible interval.
A null identifier-validity end declared UNKNOWN cannot prove that the identifier is valid at prediction.
A declared session break ends before it begins.
A session whose open is equal to its close violates strict calendar ordering.
Individually valid exchange sessions cannot overlap because session offsets would otherwise be ambiguous.
Quote and trade resume timestamps cannot precede the halt they resolve.
Resume timestamps without a corresponding halt start are internally inconsistent.
A self-asserted passing invariance boolean cannot make full-history-adjusted values point-in-time safe.
The label artifact cannot silently replace the purge rule frozen in the research contract.
Deleting the same eligible key from data and its derived manifest cannot hide it from the independent population source.
A known-time declaration cannot prove an arbitrary PIT-adjusted value without executable factor provenance.
Every clock is before prediction, but vendor, ingestion, and parse times run backward through the causal pipeline.
A genuinely preannounced future object may occur after prediction while its publication-to-parse pipeline remains causal.
JSON booleans are not numeric hard-domain bounds even though Python bool is an int subclass.
A boolean cannot impersonate the integer row count for a one-row input.
A boolean cannot impersonate the request's integer population count.
A boolean cannot impersonate the manifest and matrix-axis integer key count.
A boolean cannot impersonate a one-security lifecycle count.
A finite value inside the sourced hard domain is not failed or labeled anomalous by an undeclared universal outlier rule.
A legacy FULL request without pit_matrix_manifest_v1 remains unresolved at I001 and Q001.
A sample without a matrix receipt still detects a hard future-availability violation.
Equivalent timestamp offsets cannot evade the normalized analytical-grain uniqueness check.
An audit-side sparse cell list cannot qualify without an independently validated QRC-bound applicability proof.
A complete two-security by two-feature rectangle is the positive control for matrix completeness.

An exact interval registry without a root provenance locator cannot become complete evidence.

A trusted review registry cannot contain two conflicting authorization records for one reviewer identity.
A re-signed exact-interval generator cannot hide a second input provenance field in the closed v1 schema.
